title: Jev Decision Index
brief: A Hugging Face Space tracking benchmarks and news on the various repros of TypeSafe's Jev — a handy index if you're following the Jev model race.
details: A Hugging Face Space by multimodalart titled "Jev Decision Index", connected to the Jev retrieval tooling behind jevgrep (also in this library). The Space page is a JavaScript app whose content does not render for automated fetching, so this breakdown is thin: it appears to be an interactive demo or index around Jev's decision and relevance judgments. Worth opening directly if you use jevgrep and want to see the relevance engine's behavior firsthand.
